# Proverbs 6 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 6:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | You-have-been-ensnared by-[the]-words-of your-mouth, you-have-been-captured by-[the]-words-of your-mouth. |
| LOGOS | If you are snared in the words of your mouth, caught in the words of your mouth, |
| PNEUMA | If your own words have trapped you — if you've put yourself on the hook — |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
